title: SWI Group Raises €800M to Convert FTX Mining Assets to AI Data Centers
summary:
Genesis Digital Assets will be transformed from a crypto mining operation into a network of hubs for artificial intelligence compute. SWI Group is investing €800 million to repurpose the facility's energy and cooling infrastructure to support the capacity needs of AI firms, utilizing assets that stalled after the collapse of the cryptocurrency exchange FTX.

The investment resuscitates a business that appeared essentially abandoned after the fall of the empire led by Sam Bankman-Fried, The Wall Street Journal reported. SWI Group's acquisition follows a broader industry trend of converting high-power computing sites into the specialized infrastructure required for AI training and inference.
